description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Trincomalee District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes, specifically the postponement of local authority elections and the announcement of a new election date. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) which covers election announcements, schedules, and electoral commission decisions.
